notes.title: The IdeaBookRoom · OverWorld Island officially Release on August 18th!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is the developer of "The IdeaBookRoom" and "The IdeaBookRoom · OverWorld Island". The software offers Steam desktop and Android mobile versions.
The IdeaBookRoom
The IdeaBookRoom "is a writing and reading platform that supports multiple reading modes. During the reading process, you can see.

Currently supports both online and offline novels.

Online novels can set book prices, but currently only allow users to recharge. After purchasing a book, the author's account will increase coins, but it cannot be monetized for the author. The current function of the coin is only to purchase items in the game store.

Offline novels can be exported and imported as. shu format data packages, and can also be shared in creative workshops.
The IdeaBookRoom · OverWorld Island
The IdeaBookRoom: OverWorld Island "is a game within the bookstore. For more information, please search for The IdeaBookRoom on Bilibili.

This is a small world about genes, pets, exploration, and adventure, which is currently in its very early stages: the framework has been set up, but the plot, pet skeletons, skills, and props are still scarce.

But——

It will be permanently free!

It will be updated for a long time!

It will open a creative workshop!

That is to say, what you can play now is just a 'seed', a world that will slowly sprout over time.

Next, we will gradually update the pets, plot, and gameplay to enrich this OverWorld Island.
Recent update plan:
Add more pet skeletons

New collection/combat events

Unlock the storyline and blessing system

Basic Skills&Prop Expansion

Animation&Special Effects: Grass leaves dancing, tree cutting sound effects, and busy pet movements make exploration more realistic.

Pet Egg Hatching: Eggs will have exclusive hatching animations, and during exploration, they may also be given "blessings" to make future pets stronger!

Plot trigger: For example, the hatching of dragon eggs may open up a brand new "Dragon Island" storyline.

……
Request Support
If you like it, please add this free software 'The IdeaBookRoom' to your game library.

You can also click the 'Recharge' button in the game to recharge coins for your account (coins can be used for reading).

Support is not necessary, but it will become my motivation to keep updating.



This is still a small software and game, but it will grow step by step.

I hope everyone can try more, give more opinions, and even criticize, which is better than silence.

The IdeaBookRoom and the game OverWorld Island in the IdeaBookRoom will be officially released on August 18th. Stay tuned!
